answer_1.quote: We conduct extensive experiments across various domain-specific generation tasks, including Medical Question Answering (QA), Legal QA, and Code Generation tasks.

answer_2.quote: For the evaluation of the QA task, we employ the ROUGE-1 (R1), ROUGE-L (RL), and Perplexity (PPL) as metrics.

answer_3.quote: While automated metrics focus on lexical overlap and fluency, we also use LLM-Judge to provide a more comprehensive assessment of semantic accuracy and response quality.
